name: Local Business Schema Lite
author: Lumiverse Dynamic

sections.description:
People looking for your business want to know a few simple things: where you are, when you’re open, and how to get in touch.

Local Business Schema Lite makes it easy to share those details with search engines. Add your business information in WordPress, and the plugin prepares LocalBusiness structured data for your website. There’s no code to write and no separate service to sign up for.

Good structured data gives Google a clearer picture of the business behind your website. It brings your address, contact details, opening hours, and business type together in a format search engines can read. It’s a useful part of a well-kept local SEO setup. AI tools that use structured data can also interpret these details more easily.

What can you add?

  • Business details: name, description, address, phone, email, and website.
  • Business type: choose from 21 familiar categories, including restaurants, shops, clinics, and local services.
  • Opening hours: set a weekly schedule or mark your business as open 24/7.
  • Location: add a map link, service area, and coordinates.
  • Photos and profiles: choose a logo or image and add your Facebook and Instagram pages.
  • Price range: give visitors and search engines a little more context about your business.

Easy to set up, easy to check

The dashboard shows what you’ve entered and suggests a sensible next step. You can preview the schema before publishing it, then choose whether it appears on your homepage or throughout your website.

When your business needs more

Local Business Schema PRO builds on the easy Lite setup with more options for businesses that have a lot to share. Whether you run one busy shop or several locations, you can give search engines a fuller picture of what you do.

  • More business types: choose from a much wider range of business categories.
  • Up to five locations: manage addresses and opening hours for each location.
  • Services and specialties: describe the services you offer, with extra fields for different kinds of businesses.
  • WooCommerce support: add more detail to product schema, including brands and product identifiers.
  • Smarter setup tools: discover business details with Entity Autopilot, review your connected schema with Schema Brain, and check for possible overlaps with Conflict Shield.
  • Easy upgrade from Lite: bring your saved business details into PRO with a guided import.

Take a look at Local Business Schema PRO to see the features and choose the license that suits your website.
sections.installation:
1. Install Local Business Schema Lite from Plugins > Add New in WordPress.
  2. Activate it and open Lumiverse Schema in the admin menu.
  3. Choose your business type and add your details.
  4. Set your opening hours and add any images or social profiles you want to include.
  5. Save your settings, check the preview, and enable schema output.

That’s it. You can come back and edit your details whenever something changes.
sections.faq:
Do I need to write any code?

No. Enter your business information and the plugin creates the structured data for you.

How does this help my local SEO?

It gives Google clearer, more consistent information about your business, including its location, opening hours, and contact details. That makes it a useful addition to your local SEO work.

Can I add opening hours?

Yes. Set the days and times you’re open, or use the 24/7 option.

Can I update my business details later?

Of course. If your hours, address, or contact details change, just open the plugin settings, make your edits, and save.

What if I need more locations or extra business details?

The PRO version includes additional business types, multiple locations, a service catalog, and more tools for managing your business information.

Where can I get help?

Visit the WordPress.org support forum. We read feedback and use it to improve the plugin.
